blocks.text: Malachi 3 contains 18 verses. It opens with: Behold, I send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, will suddenly come to his temple; and the messenger of the covenant, whom ye desire, behold, he cometh, saith Jehovah of hosts. It concludes with: Then shall ye return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.
